facts: Grace's listing = TikTok Shop 1731996819249271400 (Earth Breeze official shop); Ralph 2026-10-30: build from the 8 listing images (no real photos from Grace)

box: flat slim rectangular cardboard box, portrait, about 24.7 x 16.1 x 1.1 cm (9.7 x 6.3 x 0.4 in, reseller listing), about as big as an iPad mini and as thin as a phone; sheets pull out of a slot along the top edge (L5)

box front, top to bottom: green 'FRESH SCENT' tab top-left; 'Lasts up to 60 LOADS' top-right in white beside a bubble; white arc text 'powerful clean. safe ingredients.'; 'earth breeze' logo in heavy dark navy lowercase with a light-blue and white swoosh ring behind it; white paper banner 'laundry detergent sheets' (navy); a water line; sea turtle bottom-left with a heart 'No Mess, No Plastic Jug'; navy 'NO HARSH CHEMICAL RESIDUE'; a dark navy t-shirt split down the middle (left sparkle side 'earth breeze', right 'Other Leading Brands'); '30 SHEETS 5.5" x 4.25" (14cm x 11cm)'; small HE logo and 'CAUTION: EYE IRRITANT' along the bottom
box colours: sky blue to light aqua background with bubbles, white sparkle at top centre
sheet: one plain matte WHITE thin rectangle 14 x 11 cm (5.5 x 4.25 in), like an index card but paper-thin and soft, no print, no colour (L5, L7); dissolves in the drum
use: take one sheet, toss it straight into the drum on top of the clothes, wash; hot or cold water; all machines incl. HE (L5)
pain prop in S3 only: a plain unlabeled white plastic jug (not our product, no brand); our product never appears as a jug or bottle
